title: Support: Bespoke calibration and accuracy validation for customer-requested FP8/INT8 exception
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
Customer (financial analytics customer: 'Helio Capital') reported systematic accuracy regressions when switching from our FP16 baseline to INT8 and FP8 inference profiles for their risk-scorer model (causal decoder, 7B family, long-context usage ~2048). They have requested a bespoke calibration run and an exception to the default quant profile so we can ship a patched serving config for their Dedicated instance while we investigate longer-term fixes.

Objectives:
1) Reproduce the reported accuracy delta on Redwood Dedicated (same model revision + exact input distribution)
2) Run targeted calibration runs for INT8 and FP8 using a customer-supplied calibration corpus + synthetic augmentations to match distribution
3) Produce a validated accuracy report (per-metric deltas, confidence intervals) and recommended quant-profile override (or fallback to FP16)
4) If acceptable, deliver a reversible config change for Dedicated (quant_profile_override) with rollout plan and monitoring hooks

Work completed so far (timeline):
- 2026-03-10: Support intake — received S3 link to sample corpus (s3://heliocap/quant-calib-sample/), customer reports avg token-length 320 and heavy numeric tables.
- 2026-03-11: Reproduction — cloned customer runtime snapshot on dedicated-qa pool (r1.23) and reproduced a ~3.8% drop in aggregate F1 on the sampled eval set using default INT8 profile. Logs and seed recorded: run-id qa-14011-1.
- 2026-03-12: Calibration design — created calibration plan: stratified sampling (numeric-heavy, narrative, short prompts), synthetic perturbations (number masking, measurement noise), and precision sweep (INT8 symmetric, INT8 asymmetric, FP8 E4M3 / E5M2 variants). Documented in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/Quant+Bespoke+ENG-14011
- 2026-03-13: First-pass calibration — executed FP8(E4M3) and INT8(asym) calibration runs with Redwood's calibration harness. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/eng/ENG-14011/calib-runs/. Initial metrics: INT8-asym shows -3.4% F1, FP8(E4M3) shows -1.2% F1 versus FP16 baseline.
- 2026-03-14: Peer review — PM (Sofia Chen) and Applied ML (Dr. Marco Li) reviewed preliminary results. Decision: continue deeper validation with 5x cross-split and low-latency canary plan if FP8 delta < 1.5% at 95% CI.

Open technical notes / trade-offs:
- Calibration dataset fidelity: customer corpus contains PII-like numeric strings. We must avoid long-term retention of raw data; all runs use ephemeral storage and outputs are hashed where possible.
- Batch/kernels: observed slight kernel scheduling differences for FP8 path leading to intermittent latency spikes at 95th percentile under token-burst patterns. SRE aware and tracking in ENG-14035.
- KV cache handling: calibration harness validated KV cache warm-start behavior; no regressions observed, but we must re-run full-context tests for sequence lengths > 1024.
- Acceptance threshold: PM defined acceptable accuracy regression as <=1.5% absolute F1 drop and no >5% sample-level catastrophic failures (critical numeric mispredictions).

Next steps (owner assignments):
- Diego (assignee): run full 5x cross-validation calib with stratified splits, enable per-split seed logging, and collect token-level logits for analysis (due 2026-03-18).
- Marco (Applied ML): compute statistical significance and produce recommendation for quant_profile_override vs FP16 fallback (due 2026-03-19).
- SRE (tagged via ENG-14035): validate canary autoscaling and 95p latency for FP8 kernel under production-like burst.
- PM Sofia: coordinate customer communication and approval for canary window (target 48h).

Acceptance criteria / deliverables:
- Calib report (PDF) with per-metric deltas, CI, confusion matrices and representative failure cases uploaded to Confluence and linked in the ticket.
- quant_profile_override JSON snippet that can be applied to Dedicated route (with rollback instructions) and a pre-flight checklist for Private deployments.
- Canary plan: 5% traffic, 24–48h window, automated rollback if accuracy or latency thresholds breached.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: calibration overfits to small customer sample and does not generalize. Mitigation: augment sample with synthetic perturbations and enforce cross-fold validation.
- Risk: FP8 kernel latency instability. Mitigation: SRE to gate canary and rollout with fractional traffic; if instability persists, deliver INT8 asymmetry or FP16 fallback.
- Compliance: because dataset contains sensitive fields, legal and privacy must sign off; kept in JIRA label 'sensitive-data' for audit trail.

Links / artifacts:
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/Quant+Bespoke+ENG-14011
- Calibration runs (ephemeral): s3://redwood-artifacts/eng/ENG-14011/calib-runs/
- Repro run logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/runs/qa-14011-1
- Draft PR (config override UI + API): https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8462

Reviewer feedback (selected):
- PM Sofia: "Prefer conservative rollout; customer SLA sensitive — prioritize correctness over 5–10% cost savings."
- Applied ML Marco: "FP8 shows promise but needs 5x validation; also produce per-label numeric-error metrics to evaluate catastrophic cases."
- Security (Elena): "No config changes touching KMS or keys; ensure artifacts are ephemeral and tagged for deletion after 14 days."

Activity log (updates):
- 2026-03-12: Diego — created calibration harness job and uploaded initial calibration manifest.
- 2026-03-13: Marco — computed point estimates for metric deltas; asked for 3 additional seed runs for CI.
- 2026-03-14: Sofia — approved customer-facing summary for canary request; waiting on final metrics.

User-visible communication (template) — to be sent after internal signoff:
"Helio Capital — we completed bespoke calibration and statistical validation. Recommended: apply FP8(E4M3) override under canary if observed F1 drop <=1.5% across cross-splits. If thresholds exceeded, will fallback to FP16. Next steps: schedule 48h canary window and confirm monitoring endpoints."

Notes for engineering follow-up (actionable):
- Add quant_profile_override parameter to Dedicated API with validation schema and reason field (ticket ENG-14120 created as follow-up).
- Add per-request tagging in runtime traces for quant path used (PR referenced above).
- Add automated post-canary evaluation job to compute rolling accuracy deltas and trigger rollback if needed.
